name: absolute-paths-at-tool-boundary
body:
The curated suite tools must hand consumers absolute filesystem paths even though the durable graph stores checkout-independent repo-relative identities. Each curated tool resolves a stored identity against the project `directory` it is given before returning it, so `apg_file_path`, `apg_file_units`, `apg_hunk`, … yield paths a consumer can open. Raw `apg query` is the graph view and deliberately returns the stored repo-relative form — re-basing happens only at the curated-tool boundary, never in the artifact.

Today the suite's shared plumbing only discovers the project root (`ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.findApgRoot`) and runs the fixed Cypher templates (`ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.runCypher`) from that root; once the graph's File fqn is repo-relative, the tools must join it back to the caller's project directory.

Acceptance criteria:
- A curated tool given a stored repo-relative File fqn returns an absolute path under the caller's project directory.
- The same stored identity resolves to different absolute paths in two checkouts at the same commit.
- Raw `apg query` returns the stored repo-relative form unchanged.
- The re-basing follows the tool's `directory` argument rather than cwd alone.
